note: Edwards County, TX (FIPS 48137) publishes no zoning district layer. Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. A search of ArcGIS Hub/Online for zoning and web searches found no county zoning service. The only city, Rocksprings (county seat), has a policies/ordinances page that shows no zoning map or district service. Edwards County GIS offerings found (Equator portal, Regrid, TaxNet) are parcel and CAD data with no zoning attribute.
